overview: The Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee met to review and approve the April City Council newsletter and to discuss planning and scheduling for upcoming neighborhood ward meetings.

items.title: Resolution to publish the City Council newsletter
items.summary: The committee approved the April draft of the City Council newsletter summarizing council activities, department budget requests, and school repairs.

items.title: Resolution to schedule neighborhood ward meetings
items.summary: The committee discussed scheduling, host assignments, and potential locations for ward meetings starting in September, and voted to keep the matter in committee.

subject: City Council Newsletter and Neighborhood Ward Meetings
